newsitem.title: USA: Kysor stake held by Gabelli Group.
newsitem.headline: Kysor stake held by Gabelli Group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Monday it holds a 8.13 percent stake in Kysor Industrial Corp, or 477,300 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 300,800 common shares bought between February 42 and February 20 at prices ranging from $55 to $42.9150 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.

The company, based in Cadillac, Mich., manufactures and markets commercial products including refrigerated display cases, heating and air conditioning systems for the transportation industry and various truck componets.
